Q. Why Argan+Keratin for hair?
A. The blend of Argan+Keratin is a holy grail combination for dry, frizzy & weak hair. Argan oil or “liquid gold” lubricates the hair shaft to maintain the moisture level in each strand. It nourishes the hair with a fatty layer to prevent dryness & frizziness while boosting shine.
Keratin is a type of protective protein that works as the structural building block of your hair. It repairs & treats hair cuticles to deliver visibly smoother, less frizzy hair.
Q. Will the conditioner help control hair fall?
The conditioner helps strengthen weak, limp hair that's prone to breakage. This in turn reduces hair fall to deliver voluminous, strong & shiny locks.
Q. Can this conditioner be used for coloured or chemically treated hair?
A. Yes, totally! Our conditioner is infused with 90% naturally derived ingredients devoid of any harmful chemicals which makes it super gentle for coloured & chemically treated hair. It nourishes strand by strand without causing silicone-induced dryness.
Q. Which hair type is this conditioner suitable for?
A. Our Argan Conditioner is best suited for Weak, Dull & Frizzy Hair prone to Breakage & Hairfall.
Q. Is it free from harmful chemicals?
A. Yes, our Argan Conditioner is free from Silicone, Sulphate, Parabens & any other harmful chemical that may harm your hair health.
Q. Is this a unisex product?
A. Yes. Our Argan Conditioner is a unisex product.
Q. How soon will I see the results?
A. Results are visible quite instantly. The conditioner is proven to reduce frizz while adding shine & volume from the first wash. Additionally, when used at regular intervals, it is proven to visibly reduce hair reduction in just 3 weeks.
Q. I am already using the Argan Hair Mask. Do I need to use this conditioner too?
A. Yes. While the hair mask is meant to be used once a week as a hair treatment, the conditioner can be used every day or whenever you wash your hair. While the conditioner will make your hair smoother, the hair mask will lock in the goodness of the conditioner along with adding an extra dose of nourishment to your weak, limp hair.
A. What is the recommended frequency of application?
Q. You can apply the conditioner daily or whenever you shampoo your hair.
Q. Will this conditioner weigh down my hair as I already have thin hair?
A. No. The conditioner features a creamy texture that's easy to wash off. It does not cause any residue to build up or weigh down the hair. Instead, it adds shine & volume to otherwise limp, dull hair.
Q. Suggest to me the best routined for coloured, curly hair.
A. Argan Shampoo->Argan Conditioner->Argan Hair Mask
Q. Does it straighten wavy hair?
A. No, it is not a hair-straightening conditioner. It works on frizzy hair by repairing the body of the hair strand to make it appear smooth and lustrous.
